title: Analysis: total net profit at ~190 chipmakers listed in mainland China rose 620% YoY in H1 2026, driven by the AI boom and China's self-sufficiency campaign (Tomoko Wakasugi/Nikkei Asia)
commentary: 620% profit growth at Chinese chipmakers — export controls were supposed to starve this ecosystem, not turbocharge it. Beijing's self-sufficiency campaign found the best possible accelerant: US sanctions plus an AI boom.
